title: Require Platform-Independent Service Boundaries
forbids: a Node or Bun module-loading edge from a service context, contract, schema, DTO, error, policy, or port declaration
why: Service boundary declarations must remain portable across in-process, host, and transport compositions. Concrete platform acquisition belongs at a qualified host composition root, not in service vocabulary.
remediate: Move Node and Bun acquisition to the host or edge adapter that constructs the service context. Keep service contracts, context, schemas, DTOs, errors, policy, and ports platform-neutral.
message: Service boundary declarations must not import concrete Node or Bun modules.
